task_spec.text: Identify each person named Robert who asked, in some channel, whether a deployment or rewrite was finished yet.
For each such Robert, report the workspace membership role shown on their membership pair and quote their deployment-status message.

access_plan: Use users.list (or users.info) to find users whose real_name begins with 'Robert', then use conversations.history/search.messages across their member channels (#general and #engineering) to find messages phrased as asking whether a deployment/rewrite is done; for each matched user, resolve their workspace role via their user_teams membership record surfaced through users.info/team association.
